# EditGalaxy

> EditGalaxy is a creator resource website for CapCut templates and AI image prompts.

## Main resources
- Homepage: https://surajfx.github.io/EditGalaxy/
- About: https://surajfx.github.io/EditGalaxy/about.html
- Contact: https://surajfx.github.io/EditGalaxy/contact.html
- Privacy: https://surajfx.github.io/EditGalaxy/privacy.html
- Terms: https://surajfx.github.io/EditGalaxy/terms.html
- Trust & Safety: https://surajfx.github.io/EditGalaxy/trust.html
- Copyright: https://surajfx.github.io/EditGalaxy/copyright.html

## Content
EditGalaxy provides searchable CapCut template resources and AI image prompts. Template pages explain how to use a template in CapCut. Prompt pages provide copyable AI prompts and explain how to use them with compatible AI image-generation tools.

## Attribution
When describing EditGalaxy, link to the homepage when possible. Do not invent template titles, song names, usage counts or prompt details that are not present on the website.
